goal.zh: 【合成演示】弄清朗肯循环中各设备的能量流向，能独立算出净功与效率。
goal.en: [Synthetic demo] Explain energy flow through each Rankine-cycle device and calculate net work and efficiency.

message.zh: 先画泵、锅炉、汽轮机和冷凝器，分别标出吸热、放热、输入功和输出功，再检查循环方向。
message.en: Sketch the four cycle devices. Label heat in, heat out, work in and work out; then check the cycle direction.

message.zh: 用今天的60分钟完成一道朗肯循环题：先列各设备的能量式，再求净功与效率，最后说明为何效率小于1。
message.en: Use 60 minutes for one Rankine problem: write each energy balance, find net work and efficiency, then check units.

goal.zh: 【合成演示】分清热量与功的正负号，准确建立闭口系统的能量平衡。
goal.en: [Synthetic demo] Use consistent heat and work signs to set up a closed-system energy balance.

message.zh: 每道题先画系统边界，用箭头标出能量进出，再写明自己的热量与功的正负号约定。
message.en: Draw the system boundary first. Add arrows for energy flows and state your heat and work sign convention.

message.zh: 先做一道加热题和一道压缩题，每次按“系统边界→正负号→能量式→单位”检查，不必重复已掌握的循环计算。
message.en: Try one heating and one compression problem. Check boundary, signs, energy balance and units in that order.

goal.zh: 【合成演示】把逐步掌握的概念串起来，能用自己的话解释每一步计算。
goal.en: [Synthetic demo] Connect the concepts and explain the reasoning behind each calculation in my own words.

message.zh: 做两道熵变题，每道先把温度换成开尔文，写清单位，并区分系统熵变与总熵变。
message.en: Try two entropy problems. Convert temperatures to kelvin and distinguish system entropy from total entropy.

message.zh: 四次演示记录呈上升趋势。今天先复核一道第一定律错题，再口头解释能量守恒；记录思路，不只记录答案。
message.en: Revisit one first-law error. Explain energy conservation aloud and record your reasoning as well as the answer.

goal.zh: 【合成演示】近期练习有回落，希望先找出卡住的概念，再恢复稳定的学习节奏。
goal.en: [Synthetic demo] Identify the concepts behind my recent lower scores and rebuild a manageable study routine.

message.zh: 最近两次练习比之前低，先一起看一道错题，区分是概念、单位还是计算问题；再确认你这周可用的时间。
message.en: Review one recent error together: concept, units or arithmetic? Then check how much study time fits this week.

message.zh: 先用30分钟完成一道卡诺效率题，温度统一用开尔文，再检查结果是否越过理论上限；把卡住的一步带来讨论。
message.en: Start with 30 minutes on one Carnot problem. Use kelvin, check the efficiency limit and flag the step you find hard.

goal.zh: 【合成演示】本周只能安排60分钟，希望先完成最值得投入的一项复习。
goal.en: [Synthetic demo] I have only 60 minutes this week and want one focused revision task that fits.

message.zh: 先把本周60分钟留给朗肯循环，准备好四设备示意图和一道例题，减少开始前的准备时间。
message.en: Reserve this week's 60 minutes for the Rankine cycle. Have a four-device sketch and one worked example ready.

message.zh: 这60分钟分成：15分钟画循环、30分钟独立算一道题、15分钟核对单位与效率。完成后记下一处仍不确定的地方。
message.en: Spend 15 minutes sketching, 30 solving one cycle problem and 15 checking units and efficiency. Note one uncertainty.

goal.zh: 【合成演示】各模块达到85分目标后，保持理解深度，并练习向同学解释解题思路。
goal.en: [Synthetic demo] After reaching 85 in every topic, deepen understanding by explaining solutions to a classmate.

message.zh: 熵的记录仍略低于目标，挑一道总熵变判断题，说明为什么系统熵可以减少而总熵不能为负。
message.en: Try one total-entropy question. Explain how system entropy can fall while total entropy change stays non-negative.

message.zh: 本次四个模块都达到85分目标，系统不再安排补弱任务。可自选一道综合题讲给同学听，这属于拓展建议。
message.en: Every topic meets 85, so no remedial tasks are assigned. Optional extension: explain one mixed problem to a peer.
